summary: EnrollmentEditAll is a component of the HSPnet system. It is part of the HSPnet framework used to manage and display various aspects of student enrollments within the system. This module appears to handle a variety of tasks related to displaying and editing enrollment-related information, including displaying lists of enrolled students, handling user controls for editing student preferences, confirmed enrollments, criminal records checks, and various health-related certifications.
purpose: The purpose of the EnrollmentEditAll component is to facilitate the management and editing of student enrollment-related data within the HSPnet system. It provides functionalities for managing student preferences, processing different enrollment modes, and generating displays related to student enrollment status, certification requirements, and related activities.

workflows.name: Enrollment Display
steps: Set up page based on session data and user permissions.
Load relevant user controls for enrollment editing based on the screen mode.
Sort and filter the enrollment data according to user settings.
Display filtered and sorted enrollment lists to the user.

business_rules: Only users with specific roles (e.g., PlacementCoordinator, StudentMaint) can edit enrollment data.
The ScreenMode determines which controls are visible and interactive.
validations: Ensure that UUIDs in the keys field are valid before casting and using them in queries.
Validate that user interactions adhere to defined business rules and permissions.
conditions: The display and interaction modes are influenced by the screen mode and user role.
system_behavior: The system dynamically loads and displays different user controls depending on the screen mode.
Visibility and functionality of controls are managed through user session data.
exceptions: Issue in loading user controls due to invalid user session data.
Error in processing enrollment data without correct session or user permissions.
